info.title: E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: A full-featured e-commerce API for product catalog, order processing, customer accounts, and inventory.

tags.name: products
tags.description: Browse, search, and manage the product catalog.

tags.name: orders
tags.description: Place, track, and manage customer orders.

tags.name: inventory
tags.description: Warehouse inventory levels and stock adjustments.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of products.

x-codeSamples.label: Node.js SDK

post.description: Adds a new product to the catalog. Created in `draft` status by default.

409.description: A product with this SKU already exists.

post.description: Creates an order. Payment is captured asynchronously after creation.

422.description: Order could not be processed (e.g., item out of stock).

x-codeSamples.label: Node.js SDK

post.description: Cancels a pending or processing order. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled.
Merges a secondary customer into this primary account. Irreversible.
Records a stock adjustment (receiving, damaged goods, cycle count, etc.).
Triggers a full inventory reconciliation. Expensive operation — use sparingly.

price.description: Price in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).

price_override.description: Overrides the base product price if set.

x-enumDescriptions.draft: Not yet published; visible only to administrators.
x-enumDescriptions.archived: Retired from the catalog but retained for order history.
x-enumDescriptions.out_of_stock: Temporarily unavailable. Set automatically when all variant inventory reaches zero.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

total.description: Order total in smallest currency unit.

payment_method_id.description: ID of a saved payment method.

unit_price.description: Price per unit at time of purchase.

x-enumDescriptions.pending: Order received, payment not yet captured.
x-enumDescriptions.processing: Being picked and packed in the warehouse.
x-enumDescriptions.shipped: In transit to the delivery address.

reorder_threshold.description: Alert triggered when available drops below this.

quantity_delta.description: Positive for stock in, negative for stock out.

x-enumDescriptions.theft: Loss attributed to theft or shrinkage.
x-enumDescriptions.other: Reason not covered by other categories.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for public storefront operations.
